title: Handle cross-checkpoint changes without losing the route
summary: Target the smallest affected module or fact; preserve the paused task and old versions. Inspect recorded dependencies and actual code, then explain any downstream effects before changing the agreed plan.
body: A dependency query finds recorded links only; it is not a semantic oracle. Commit with explicit file paths and inspect staged diff; never include unrelated dirty changes, .env, raw logs or generated resumes. A technical completion uses review status; accepted requires the actual user statement and source. That record is provenance, not cryptographic proof of human identity. Distinguish a new fact within a module from a change to that module's input/output contract. A fact may require new selection or writing for a relevant JD without redesigning the whole pipeline. A contract change can cross modules: mark only inspected consumers as needs_review. impact returns candidates, not automatic invalidation.
change_reason: Clarify localized data changes and cross-module contract changes
